notes.title: Quipu Runner | Linux Patch
notes.content:
[b]🌞  Quipu Runner: Warmi’s Legacy – Linux Patch Update! 🛠️
[/b]
Today marks a huge milestone—we officially opened our Steam store and welcomed adventurers into the world of Quipu Runner: Warmi’s Legacy! 🎉 Among our first wave of explorers, we saw Linux players stepping into the journey, and we couldn’t be more thrilled! 🚀

However, every great adventure has its challenges, and we quickly noticed some Linux-specific issues. Our team worked swiftly to ensure a smoother, more immersive experience for our Linux players.

[b]🔧 Patch Highlights:
[/b]✔️ Enhanced Linux OS compatibility
✔️ Performance optimizations for smoother gameplay
✔️ Fixes for graphical and input issues

Your journey through ancient mysteries and untold legends should be seamless, no matter your platform. Thank you for being part of this adventure from Day 1—your feedback fuels our passion! 💙

Stay tuned for more updates, and keep exploring the legacy of Quipu Runners! 🌎✨
